case.narrative: I had an accident on I-85 I was rear ended after traffic slammed on breaks and the car behind had been riding my bumper for miles. He went through my trunk and almost came into my backseat. I was also pushed into the car infront of me which his directly on the drivers side of my car. My front end is completely pushed on the drivers side into to where you can see the metal frame. On the rear, the bumper and metal frame completely came off.   I was hit directly on impact sensors on both ends and none of my airbags went off. And my seatbelt did not lock up.   We were still going about 60-70mph when he hit me. The car is a total loss.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
